Wilkes-Barre, PA, April 18, 2024 – Kallisti Publishing Inc., a leading publisher of personal development and business books, proudly announces the acquisition of the English rights to The Red Bull Story: The Unbelievable Success of Dietrich Mateschitz by Wolfgang Fürweger from Carl Ueberreuter Verlag GmbH . This acquisition marks a significant milestone for Kallisti Publishing as it secures the exclusive rights to publish the only biography available in English about the enigmatic founder of Red Bull, Dietrich Mateschitz.
Wolfgang Fürweger , an esteemed author and journalist, delves deep into the captivating narrative of Dietrich Mateschitz’s extraordinary journey in The Red Bull Story . From the inception of the iconic energy drink to its meteoric rise as a global powerhouse, Fürweger provides readers with unparalleled insight into the visionary leadership and innovative strategies that propelled Red Bull to unparalleled success.
